threat_event: Ransomware spreads through the corporate directory to plant OT and DC automation and halts production and deliveries in several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT servers at Plants 2 and 5 and DC automation servers are joined to the corporate domain; 34 privileged service accounts outside PAM; flat IT and OT networks at Plants 2 and 5
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; SYS-M1 to SYS-M3 (Plants 2 and 5); SYS-D1; SYS-R3
regulatory_driver: 9 CFR 417.3(b); 21 CFR 117.206(a)(3); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; state breach laws (each state where affected individuals reside)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on IT; immutable cloud backups; separate OT domain at Plants 1, 3, 4, and 6
treatment_plan: Move Plants 2 and 5 OT and DC automation to the OT domain behind SYS-G5; bring all privileged service accounts into PAM; offline OT backups; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: Outage or compromise of the shared cold-chain monitoring platform blinds temperature monitoring at plants, DCs, trailers, and stores at the same time
threat_source: Ransomware or platform failure; vendor outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One alert integration server with no tested failover routes every alert; gateways at DCs and stores sit on general networks; alerts not in the SOC; vendor assurance not reviewed since 2024
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G6; BP-G04, BP-M01, BP-D01, BP-D03, BP-R02
existing_controls: Gateways buffer 24 hours; manual temperature log procedures at plants
treatment_plan: Active-active alert integration with a tested failover; alerts into the SOC; gateways on segmented networks; vendor SOC 2 review and security terms

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses a food safety, breach, card brand, or SEC notification clock
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix in draft and never exercised; SOC playbooks do not include the food safety decision; several regulators and contracts at once
regulatory_driver: 9 CFR 418.2; 21 U.S.C. 350f(d); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Fla. Stat. 501.171 (worked example)
existing_controls: Group incident response plan; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Complete the matrix with every division regulator and contract; cross-division tabletop with a materiality decision and an FSIS notice decision

threat_event: AI on food safety paths or with customers fails or is misused without adequate governance
threat_source: AI system failure; vendor change; misuse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI vision inspection in production at three plants before the Group AI Standard; loss-prevention camera analytics pilot without privacy review
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-M6; store CCTV analytics; loyalty offers
regulatory_driver: 9 CFR 417.4(a)(3) (if AI affects a CCP); FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02)
existing_controls: Metal detector CCPs and manual inspection unchanged; Group AI Standard adopted 2026
treatment_plan: Group AI program (P10): register, tier, validate, and approve every use case; conditions on AI-001 and AI-005

threat_event: Staff follow drifted division standards that conflict with group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Food Distribution standards (2023) predate the 2025 group policies and were never re-aligned
existing_controls: Group policies 2025
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Food Distribution supplement; annual alignment attestation for all divisions
owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead

threat_event: Food Distribution cannot show which of its controls are met by group common controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Common control inheritance not documented for Food Distribution
affected_asset_or_process: Food Distribution; P02 common control catalog
existing_controls: Common control catalog (2025)
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix for Food Distribution, confirmed by group internal audit
owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead

threat_event: Group identity platform outage stops sign-in across all divisions
threat_source: Identity SaaS outage or directory failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity platform; directory restore tested once (2025)
existing_controls: Break-glass accounts per critical system; separate OT domain at four plants
treatment_plan: Twice-yearly directory restore test; break-glass test each quarter

threat_event: A critical SaaS supplier (ERP, WMS, or TMS) suffers a long outage or breach affecting several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group ERP and WMS are single-vendor SaaS; vendor assurance reviewed annually
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 reviews; contractual recovery commitments
treatment_plan: Manual operating procedures tested in each division; continuous monitoring of tier 1 suppliers

threat_event: Intentional adulteration of product through the control system or recipe library at a plant
threat_source: Insider or external attacker with OT or recipe access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared HMI logins at all plants and shared MES logins at Plants 2 and 5; Plant 6 vulnerability assessment omitted control-system paths; recipe library administrators in the cloud
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-M1; SYS-M3; recipe master library; Plant 6 plant-based line
regulatory_driver: C-FOOD-AG-R01 (121.130; 121.135; 121.157) for Plant 6; FSIS voluntary food defense guidance for Plants 1 to 5
existing_controls: Two-person formulation approval at four plants; physical food defense measures; CIP interlocks on meat brine systems
treatment_plan: Named HMI accounts; two-person approval at all plants; recipe library change alerts to FSQA; Plant 6 food defense reanalysis
owner: Group Chief Food Safety and Quality Officer

threat_event: Theft of employee personal information for the whole workforce
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR file shares and payroll exports hold SSNs and bank details for 45,000 employees; data loss prevention covers email only
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: Access restricted to HR; EDR; SOC monitoring
treatment_plan: Move HR exports to the HR SaaS; egress alerts on HR shares; purge legacy exports

threat_event: Cardholder data is compromised in stores or online
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 30 stores outside P2PE; one store network design lets the Wi-Fi management network reach POS; payment page script inventory incomplete
regulatory_driver: N44-45-R01 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 1, 6.4, 11.4, 11.6); state breach laws
existing_controls: P2PE in 90 stores; quarterly scans; annual ROC
treatment_plan: Fix the store design (12 stores); replace 30 stores' terminals; complete script inventory and tamper detection

threat_event: An OT vendor remote access path is used to reach plant or DC control systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator shared always-on VPN (Plants 2 and 5); contractor cellular modem (Plant 5); AI vision vendor remote tool; DC automation vendor access outside SYS-G5 at three DCs
regulatory_driver: C-FOOD-AG-R01 (121.135(a)) for Plant 6; NIST CSF 2.0 benchmark (voluntary)
existing_controls: SYS-G5 gateway with MFA at four plants and two DCs
treatment_plan: Extend SYS-G5 to Plants 2 and 5 and three DCs; remove the modem and the shared VPN; vendor security terms

threat_event: Unsupported operating systems in OT at acquired plants are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 24 HMIs at Plants 2 and 5 run an unsupported operating system
existing_controls: None beyond perimeter controls
treatment_plan: Allowlisting now; replace HMIs in the 2027 capital plan
owner: Meat Processing security and compliance lead

threat_event: Consumer personal information (loyalty and online accounts) is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6.5 million loyalty members in one platform; credential stuffing against accounts
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (each state where affected individuals reside); FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02)
existing_controls: Bot protection; MFA option for accounts; encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Risk-based step-up authentication; minimize exports from the loyalty platform
owner: Grocery Retail security and compliance lead

threat_event: The SOC cannot see attacks in OT at two plants and three DCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT monitoring or EDR on OT hosts at Plants 2 and 5 and DC-2, DC-4, and DC-5; cold-chain alerts not sent to the SOC
existing_controls: OT monitoring at four plants and two DCs
treatment_plan: Extend OT monitoring; forward cold-chain and historian events to the SIEM

threat_event: Tampering with refrigeration controls causes an ammonia release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor modem on the Plant 5 controller; default credentials found on OT devices
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-M4; DC-1 and DC-3 freezer controls
existing_controls: PSM programs; hardwired ammonia detection and alarms; manual operation procedures
treatment_plan: Remove the modem; controller access only through SYS-G5; credential change sweep

threat_event: The group misstates its cybersecurity governance in SEC disclosure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Item 106 description drafted from policy documents; OT and division gaps not reflected
existing_controls: Disclosure committee review
treatment_plan: Tie the Item 106 draft to the group risk register and P07 results

threat_event: 3PL customer data or temperature records are exposed to another customer or altered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single multi-customer portal; authorization tested only at release
existing_controls: Role-based access per customer; annual penetration test
treatment_plan: Authorization tests in every release; integrity protection for temperature history

threat_event: Traceability data across plants, DCs, and stores cannot be joined quickly enough for a recall
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lot data in MES, WMS, and store systems with different keys; manual joins
existing_controls: Annual mock recall per plant
treatment_plan: Common lot key across divisions; a group mock recall that includes DC and store records
owner: Group Chief Food Safety and Quality Officer

threat_event: OT software, firmware, or AI model updates from suppliers carry malicious code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrators and vendors push updates without integrity checks; AI vision model updates pushed without notice
existing_controls: Change control at four plants
treatment_plan: Signed update verification; all OT updates through change control with FSQA sign-off
